explanation: This method is vulnerable to SQL injection (CWE-89) because an f-string embeds attacker-controllable HTTP request fields (such as user_agent, referrer, and full_path) directly inside single quotes in the INSERT query. An attacker sending crafted headers or URLs could escape the string literals and execute arbitrary SQL statements. The repair uses unquoted %s placeholders and passes all five values as a bound tuple to cursor.execute().
